fx: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production VFX sprite atlas for top-down cartoon sci-fi roguelite Hexblast. Input reference: match chunky saturated blue ice facets, bold cartoon shapes and crisp white highlights of reference animation. Make ONE square transparent RGBA sprite sheet containing exactly 4 rows by 4 columns, equal square cells, 16 separate sprites, generous TRANSPARENT gutters. No grid drawn, no letters, no text, no ground, no shadows, no opaque background. Each sprite centered exactly in its cell, same pivot. Animation progresses left to right: small initial manifestation, strong main burst, separated outward fragments, few fading fragments. Row 1 GOLD THUNDER: forked short golden lightning arcs shatter outward from white-yellow flash, amber dark contour, electrical jagged chunks, no fire or smoke. Row 2 ICE SHATTER: blue crystalline spikes burst around an OPEN CENTER then separate as ice shards, cyan and white faceted material. Row 3 WARM LIGHT: ivory/gold four-point prism flare then rays splitting into diamonds, clean radiant solid strokes, transparent open gaps, not a full-screen flash. Row 4 SHADOW CORROSION: dark purple crescent claw wisps curl inward around an OPEN transparent center, break into purple shard wisps, lilac bright edges, no black opaque disk. Strict cell boundaries, all content inside central 75 percent of each cell. All VFX are compact readable hit effects, NO full circles or rings, NO round explosion fireballs. High quality hand-painted cel-shaded game VFX.
